hebrewText: וַ/נֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל אֲדֹנִ֔/י יֶשׁ לָ֨/נוּ֙ אָ֣ב זָקֵ֔ן וְ/יֶ֥לֶד זְקֻנִ֖ים קָטָ֑ן וְ/אָחִ֨י/ו מֵ֜ת וַ/יִּוָּתֵ֨ר ה֧וּא לְ/בַדּ֛/וֹ לְ/אִמּ֖/וֹ וְ/אָבִ֥י/ו אֲהֵבֽ/וֹ

tokens.kjv: answer, appoint, avouch, bid, boast self, call, certify, challenge, charge, [phrase] (at the, give) command(-ment), commune, consider, declare, demand, [idiom] desire, determine, [idiom] expressly, [idiom] indeed, [idiom] intend, name, [idiom] plainly, promise, publish, report, require, say, speak (against, of), [idiom] still, [idiom] suppose, talk, tell, term, [idiom] that is, [idiom] think, use (speech), utter, [idiom] verily, [idiom] yet.

tokens.kjv: lord, master, owner. Compare also names beginning with 'Adoni-'.

tokens.bdb: there is or are (or any other form of the verb to be, as may suit the connection)
tokens.kjv: (there) are, (he, it, shall, there, there may, there shall, there should) be, thou do, had, hast, (which) hath, (I, shalt, that) have, (he, it, there) is, substance, it (there) was, (there) were, ye will, thou wilt, wouldest.

aged, ancient (man), elder(-est), old (man, men and...women), senator.

tokens.bdb: something born, i.e. a lad or offspring
tokens.kjv: boy, child, fruit, son, young man (one).

tokens.bdb: abbreviated, i.e. diminutive, literally (in quantity, size or number) or figuratively (in age or importance)
tokens.kjv: least, less(-er), little (one), small(-est, one, quantity, thing), young(-er, -est).

tokens.bdb: a brother (used in the widest sense of literal relationship and metaphorical affinity or resemblance (like father))
tokens.kjv: another, brother(-ly); kindred, like, other. Compare also the proper names beginning with 'Ah-' or 'Ahi-'.

tokens.bdb: to die (literally or figuratively); causatively, to kill
